runtime_table_access_separation.conclusion: The FC20 runtime-table decoder writes 34 direct fields at offsets 0x00..0x82 of DAT_08038694 (with gaps), and no direct field at +0x9c or +0x9e. This is negative evidence only and does not exclude pointer-propagated aliases or omitted initialization code.
